answer: Since the throttle counters live in the pigment ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 45 keys therefore burns for 45 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the bridge quota and the opal admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 6 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole farm at once. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
